thread:
Maya Chen: Support escalated — customer acme-inc reporting p99 jump on /chat since ~00:12 UTC. p95 stable, p99 from ~350ms -> ~1.8s. They said it started after maintenance window.
Ashwin Rao: Thanks Maya. Any request ids or example traces? can you paste a sample request id?
Maya Chen: Request ids: req-9a3f, req-9a40. Traces show a lot of "kernel_choice=autoselect" and a few "fallback to generic-kernel" logs.
Taylor Ng: Was there a runtime rollout at that window? any deploy-bot messages?
infra-bot: deploy finished: runtime-v2.17.3 rolled at 00:05 UTC to us-west-2 (canary -> global).
Kevin Liu: v2.17.3 included attention autoselect heuristic tuning + new compile flag ENABLE_ATTEN_HYSTERESIS. Looking.
Samir Patel: p95 ok but p99 spikes — suggests intermittent kernel misselect on long contexts. Maya can you confirm sequence lengths for the affected requests?
Maya Chen: ACME payloads show median seq_len 128 but 5% tail at 1024. The spike traces map to seq_len=1024.
Ashwin Rao: That fits. Hysteresis change might reduce stickiness and cause oscillation near the 512-768 boundary under bursty mixed-length traffic.
Taylor Ng: I'll run a repro hitting their model variant with mixed seqs (128 / 1024) and similar concurrency.
Kevin Liu: Also check compiled kernel variants and timings. If ENABLE_ATTEN_HYSTERESIS is true we may see more frequent kernel switches.
Samir Patel: Quick mitigation: toggle attention.autoselect.hysteresis=false for the affected shard so we fall back to previous behaviour. Ops can flip via runtime config.
Maya Chen: Customer ok with temporary toggle; asked for rollback option if no improvement.
Ashwin Rao: Pushing soft toggle to shard: 10% traffic to test.
infra-bot: config update submitted: attention.autoselect.hysteresis=false to shard us-west-2-customer-ACME (10%).
Taylor Ng: Repro harness running — 500 rps with 15% tail at seq 1024. Baseline p99 ~1.9s. Will report delta after toggle.
Kevin Liu: Also collect kernel selection histograms (kernel counts per seq bin) and per-kernel latencies. Need to ensure Flash vs SDPA distribution.
Samir Patel: If toggle helps, plan to revert the heuristic-tuning and ship a conservative hysteresis (lock for 30s per kernel) + regression tests.
Maya Chen: Canary update: 10% group p99 dropped to ~420ms, canary traces show fewer kernel switches.
Ashwin Rao: Rolling to 100% for that shard now.
infra-bot: config update: attention.autoselect.hysteresis=false to shard us-west-2-customer-ACME (100%) — applied.
Taylor Ng: After full toggle p99 across ACME traffic stable at 380-450ms. Continuing longer-run repro to ensure no recurrence.
Kevin Liu: I'll open a revert PR for ENABLE_ATTEN_HYSTERESIS and iterate on a better hysteresis algorithm + unit/regression tests. Target patch next week.
Samir Patel: Add a regression test in the kernel-selection sim to exercise mixed-seq bursts and ensure hysteresis doesn't thrash.
Maya Chen: Customer updated: they see improvement and appreciate quick action. I'll prepare a short customer-facing RCA (cause, mitigation, next steps).
Taylor Ng: Action items: 1) collect long-run histograms and kernel switch rates 2) add regression tests 3) submit revert PR + better hysteresis 4) notify CS when closed. ✅
Ashwin Rao: Nice quick ops everyone. :thumbsup:
